Don’t feel like writing it
every night?

Pick a topic instead of writing it, and the greeting changes daily.
Today’s weather, a reminder to take your medication, or a line of fortune.

language.bullet2: Fortune and words of love come with a voice of your own

scenarios.headline: What it says in the morning.

Not sure what to put in? Start with one of these.
The weather and medication lines already ship with the app.

items.tag: If you have a favorite voice
items.title: "Time to get up. Let’s have a good one today."
items.body:
Lift a voice from a video you love and let it open your morning.
Make it once, then change the words as often as you like.

items.title: "It’s time for your medicine. Take it now with a glass of water, before it slips your mind."
items.body:
Set your parents’ alarm for them when you can’t check in as often as you’d like.
You don’t have to write this line yourself.

items.title: "Sleep well? Have a good day."
items.body:
Set their morning alarm in your own voice.
Once it arrives it’s theirs — they can move the time however they want.

items.tag: If writing lines is a chore
items.title: "It’s really cold out today. Bundle up in a warm coat before you head out."
items.body:
Pick weather and it chooses a greeting to match the sky that morning.
Clear, rain, snow, cold — a different line each day.

items.q: How do I make a voice?
items.a: Record something or upload an audio file. Recordings run from 12 seconds up to 2 minutes. If you don’t have a file, playing a video of that person and recording it works too. Once the voice exists, every line you write is read back in it, on as many alarms as you like. Adding a voice of your own needs a plan, and you can create one per month.

items.q: Are there forced missions, like math or photo challenges?
items.a: No. AlarmTalk is built around emotional waking, not forced waking. The goal is to wake up to a voice you genuinely want to hear.

Two groups. Fans who want to wake up to their favorite idol, voice actor, or character — and seniors and long-distance families who want their child, grandchild, or partner's voice every morning. Both share one thing: a specific voice they want to hear daily.
Android only for now. There is no iOS app yet, and no release date we can share.

footer.tagline: Wake up to a voice you love. Register once, then any line you write is read in that voice.

meta.title: Company
meta.description: AlarmTalk redefines an alarm not as a sound, but as a relationship. Our mission, our principles, and what we're building.

hero.description: AlarmTalk redefines an alarm as a relationship instead of a sound. Starting every morning's first second with a fresh line in a voice you love — that's our single job.

principles.headline: Five principles we work by
principles.description: We are early — going from zero to one. That's exactly why clear principles matter more, not less.

items.title: Build something people want every day
items.body: Not a one-time trick. The first thing people meet every morning.

items.title: Treat trust as the heaviest constraint
items.body: Voice cloning shares roots with voice phishing. Closed sharing and no-export are non-negotiable.

items.title: Emotion over force
items.body: Not a louder alarm — one you actually want to hear. We wake the mind, not just the body.

items.title: Ask for a 10× answer
items.body: We don't chase 10% gains. We look for an answer that is 10× different — a third path beyond beeps and missions.

items.title: Build globally from day one
items.body: Not a Korea-only product. We assume a multilingual, multicultural user from the first commit.
